title: High Priestly Ministry of Christ
definition: The high priestly ministry of Christ is His work of offering Himself, interceding for His people, and bringing them near to God.
summary: Jesus is the great High Priest who offered Himself once for all.
christFocus: Christ's priesthood gives believers access, mercy, cleansing, and ongoing help.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus is the great High Priest. Unlike earthly priests, He is sinless, eternal, and His sacrifice does not need to be repeated.

He offered Himself once for all, entered the heavenly presence, and lives to intercede for His people.

His priesthood gives believers confidence to draw near to God for mercy and grace in time of need.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people feel too guilty or weak to approach God. The high priestly ministry of Christ matters because He has opened the way and continues to help His people.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Draw near to God through Christ. Bring guilt, weakness, temptation, and need to the High Priest who gives mercy and grace.
